name: VerusBridge duplicate-state-root parser divergence

classification.summary: The bridge accepted notarization bytes whose duplicate state-root entries were interpreted differently by Verus and Ethereum, installing an attacker-chosen root and authorizing unbacked imports.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

lastCodeChange.description: 2026-07-12T16:57:35Z (block 25517881, tx 0xb29f45f3c788cc635fe746754dfe79b00f36758cbd9f418e69866e72c08e192d): last delegate-contract swap on the Verus Delegator before the incident, recovered by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt over the contracts address[] (length slot 13, data at keccak256(13)+i); it replaced 8 of the 11 modules four days after the 2026-07-08 post-hack redeploy (block 25488591)

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/verusbridge.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.

sources.note: onchain review: same Verus Delegator 0x71518580f36feceffe0721f06ba4703218cd7f63 as the 2026-05-17 incident; because it emits no upgrade event the code history was recovered in Tier 2 by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt over the contracts address[] (length slot 13, data at keccak256(13)+i) between creation block 18272987 and incident block 25592836. After the May incident every module was replaced twice: contracts[3], [4] and [7] on 2026-07-08T14:57:23Z (block 25488591, tx 0xdcd9821ff75561c03f85673d992ad988f7d067caf1f3df581ac54303537ff84a) and contracts[0], [1], [2], [5], [6], [8], [9], [10] on 2026-07-12T16:57:35Z (block 25517881, tx 0xb29f45f3c788cc635fe746754dfe79b00f36758cbd9f418e69866e72c08e192d), both from the Verus upgrade signer 0x896e59efcbec700bc9f447af7018bdc5ca1fa5ab with selector 0x60cd61a5. Age measured from the 2026-07-12 swap, 10.5 days before the exploit, rather than the 2023 Delegator deployment

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/verusbridge.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
